Resource initialization and Fourier event with D allowed above 2

Scope: conditional analytic extension of two specific generic-gap shortcuts.
This does not acquire support, moments, gap endpoints, INITIAL covers, count
resources, or any cutoff. Every retained positivity/damping/phase gate stays.

Assume one attained unrestricted contrary witness has been proved to satisfy
rho>=rho_l>=1, physical defect0<=D<=d with0<d<(sqrt(10)-1)rho_l, an actual central gap
(-A,B), A,B>0, and p in[l,u] strictly inside(0,1). A previous valid INITIAL
also provides theta<=Theta<1, and optional nonnegative floors A>=A_l,B>=B_l.
The strict defect inequality licenses the actual gap by the supplied gap
identity, before using any sign-conditional decomposition.

1. A positive lower bound for the sum of gap endpoints, without D<2.
Write sigma=sqrt(10), m=E X_+=E X_-<=1/2. The retained gap decomposition
implies T_++T_-<=D/(sigma-1) and m(A^2+B^2)=rho-T_+-T_-.
Consequently
 (A+B)^2 >= A^2+B^2 >=2rho-2D/(sigma-1).
If s is a rational lower bound1<s<sigma and d<(s-1)rho_l, then
 G=sqrt_lower(2rho_l-2d/(s-1))>0
is valid. It may be replaced by max(G,A_l+B_l) when those floors are valid.

2. Initialize or retain positive endpoints using the existing joint budget.
The retained simultaneous inequality gives
 6m(A+B)(Delta_A+Delta_B)<=D<=d,
where conditional means have magnitudes Abar=m/(1-p), Bbar=m/p and
Delta_A=Abar-A, Delta_B=Bbar-B are nonnegative.
Since m^2=(1-theta)p(1-p), put
 m_l=sqrt_lower((1-Theta)*min(l(1-l),u(1-u)))>0.
Then Delta_A+Delta_B<=d/(6m_l G). Therefore
 A>=max(A_l,sqrt_lower((1-Theta)l/(1-l))-d/(6m_l G)),
 B>=max(B_l,sqrt_lower((1-Theta)(1-u)/u)-d/(6m_l G)).
These are exactly the retained initialization formulas with a different,
proved lower bound G for A+B. If both pre-existing A_l,B_l are positive,
using them directly is also valid. A nonpositive computed floor is an
unresolved domain failure, never a law exclusion.

2a. Additional endpoint floors using the literal third-moment lower bound.
The stronger retained gap-mass estimate is J<=rho+2mAB. Since gamma<=rho,
 D=(3+sigma)rho-gamma-3J >=(sigma-1)rho-6mAB.
Put price=(s-1)rho_l-d>0. Since B<=m/p and A<=m/(1-p),
 mB<=m^2/p=(1-theta)(1-p)<=1-p,
 mA<=m^2/(1-p)=(1-theta)p<=p.
Thus the same-law endpoints satisfy
 A>=price/(6(1-p))>=price/(6(1-l)),
 B>=price/(6p)>=price/(6u).
These can be intersected with the previous floors before initialization or
on each subsequent step with an already proved d andrho_l. This strengthens
the old price=s-1-d using the actual literalrho_l; no new budget is spent.
The inequality J<=rho+2mAB follows directly from J=m(A+B)^2+J_outer,
J_outer<=T_++T_-, andrho=m(A^2+B^2)+T_++T_-.

3. Subsequent generic resource steps.
The exact same joint budget, binary-square subtraction, residual pricing,
conditional variance update and endpoint updates apply to any actual positive
central gap. They have no assumption D<2. The general_cell code must retain
all its positive coefficient, variance, endpoint, moment and ordering gates.
Generic initialization via general_geometry(d) is not invoked by this route.
No estimate containing sqrt(2-d) may be evaluated when d>=2.

4. Complete HIGH event in subsequent general or signed-paired envelopes.
For E={XX'<0}, P(E)=2p(1-p)>=2min(l(1-l),u(1-u)) and
|X-X'|>=A+B>=A_l+B_l>0. Its second distance moment is <=2/P(E),
so the retained HIGH_WINDOW50 theorem applies with
 d0=A_l+B_l
or max(A_l+B_l,G), and with all six pieces and damping gates unchanged.
This replaces only the former max(A_l+B_l,sqrt_lower(2-d)) shortcut.
The generic and signed-paired formulas must both use the revised event input
if both are enabled. Their other moment, sign, denominator, actual-C and
phase-curvature requirements are unchanged; eligibility is not widened by
this note. The earlier M<3 paired formula is not sufficient for rho_l>=1.75;
a separately justified general signed-Pearson coefficient theorem is needed.

5. Conserved phase prices.
The retained phase derivation requires a positive density floor and
.4095*rho-d/15>0. Those gates must still be checked. The logical scope is the
actual fixed index; a floor-index nD<=Nd record must first be interpreted as
an upper bound for the physical D at the actual index. This note does not
justify copying a noise price between different indices.

Implementation status: this note is the conditional derivation only. A new,
separately named implementation must identify every replaced sqrt(2-d), bind
these premises, and recompute all resources before any count implication.
